scope: Fish R012 receipt lineage; Tailor N123 replay; Human EAR single-Mother provenance trial candidate
trigger: A tested implementation is followed by receipt/task-anchor commits, or an artifact is delivered with a self-authored digest but without verifiable producer/workflow identity.
requiredInputs: complete changed-path set from tested subject
gate: The tested subject must be an ancestor of the receipt/head.
The receipt must bind the exact tested subject and run/job evidence.
Every descendant change must be inside the explicit metadata allowlist.
Any runtime, source, workflow, public artifact, or unrelated policy delta requires a new test or HOLD.
Human and machine claims must name the tested subject; a mutable branch head cannot inherit the word tested.

terminalAttempt.failedStep: All-preset browser, exports, real source regeneration and mobile layout

evidenceUpdates.novelty: NO_NOVELTY; native generation and card enumeration cannot transfer tested status to a failed browser-regenerated subject or to an unexecuted public delivery

evidenceUpdates.observedGap: The workflow uploads ear-r03-audit with actions/upload-artifact@v4 but has no attestations:write/id-token:write permission, no actions/attest step and no attestation verification. Current digest/run receipts remain valid scoped evidence but are self-authored lineage claims.
evidenceUpdates.novelty: Cryptographic subject-digest plus signer repository/workflow/source identity is not present in R2 Delivery Receipt or prior tested-subject lineage fields; it complements rather than replaces them.

teacher.provenance: Official GitHub Actions organization; signed immutable release commit; public repository.
teacher.maintenance: Repository pushed 2026-10-06 and had active scheduled Sigstore prober runs observed 2026-10-12.
teacher.executableEvidence: Node24 action, unit/integration test directories, published releases and public Sigstore probing.
teacher.directNovelty: Binds a named artifact digest to a signed in-toto/SLSA predicate and GitHub Actions OIDC identity, allowing verification against expected repository/workflow/source instead of trusting a copied receipt digest.

attestationExtensionCandidate.applicability: Single-Mother trial only for CI-built user-visible HTML/audit artifacts; does not attest manual local builds unless a separate trusted builder exists.
boundary: A valid attestation proves provenance/integrity only; it does not prove reference fidelity, visual quality, browser/device runtime, physics, independent verifier approval or USER-ACCEPTED.
Verification policy must bind repository, workflow, source SHA/ref and artifact digest; signature-valid alone is insufficient.
The action should be pinned to an immutable full commit during trial, not only a mutable major tag.
Failure of the external attestation service must fail closed for provenance claims but must not erase previously verified scoped production facts.
attestationExtensionCandidate.falsifiableHypothesis: The extension must distinguish a stale artifact relabeled by a fresh receipt, an unsigned copied digest, a valid signature from the wrong workflow/source, and a correctly attested artifact whose semantic gates still fail. If it cannot, reject the Candidate.

activation.rollback: Do not activate globally. Remove the attestation extension if one real single-Mother trial adds no discrimination beyond exact digest/run receipts or causes unacceptable service coupling.
